# `openm2` messages

openm2's own protocol, between its client and its server.

A message is its id, a LEB128 varint, then its fields in order; on the wire each message follows its length, also a varint ([`README.md`](README.md)). Integers are little-endian. `string<N>` is a u16 byte length, then at most N bytes of UTF-8; `blob<N>` a u16 length, then at most N bytes; `list<T; N>` a u16 count, then at most N items; `opt<T>` a 0, or a 1 and then the value; `bool` a 0 or a 1. Ids are per direction. Behaviour (when each message is sent and what the other side does) is described in the other files of this folder.

## Client → server

| Id | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Hello | The client's first message: the protocol version it speaks and its build. |
| 2 | Pong | Answer to a Ping. |
| 4 | TicketLogin | Logs in on the game server with the ticket the auth server gave. |
| 5 | CreateCharacter | Creates a character in a free slot of the account. |
| 6 | SelectCharacter | Plays the character in a slot of the character list. |
| 7 | EnterGame | The client has loaded the map and is ready to play. |
| 8 | SendChat | A chat line or chat command typed by the player. |
| 9 | CharacterMove | Our character starts walking to a point, stops, attacks or plays a skill's motion. |
| 10 | UseItem | Uses the item in a slot: wears it, takes it off, or uses it up. |
| 11 | MoveItem | Moves an item to another slot. |
| 12 | SetQuickSlot | Puts an item or a skill on a quickslot. |
| 13 | ClearQuickSlot | Empties a quickslot. |
| 14 | SwapQuickSlots | Swaps what two quickslots hold. |
| 15 | SetTarget | Chooses the entity we look at; the server answers with its health. |
| 16 | Hit | One of our attacks or skills hit an entity; the server works out the damage. |
| 17 | PickUp | Picks up an item from the ground. |
| 18 | DropItem | Drops some of the item in a slot of the bag where our character stands. |
| 19 | DropGold | Drops some of our gold where our character stands. |
| 20 | Talk | Talks to an NPC near us; its shop opens if it has one. |
| 21 | ShopBuy | Buys what lies in a place of the open shop. |
| 22 | ShopSell | Sells some of the item in a slot of the bag to the open shop. |
| 23 | ShopClose | Closes the open shop. |
| 24 | UseSkill | Uses one of our skills, after the CharacterMove with its motion. |
| 25 | RaiseSkill | Spends a skill point on one of our skills. |
| 26 | Restart | Comes back to life after dying, where we fell or in town. |
| 27 | StartSignIn | Asks the auth server for the providers it signs in with, and a nonce for this connection. |
| 28 | ProviderLogin | Signs in with a provider, on the auth server: the code the provider gave, for the server to exchange. |
| 29 | LeaveGame | Leaves the game for the character list, on the same connection: the server saves our character and sends the list again. |
| 30 | RaiseStatus | Spends a status point on one of our four stats. |
| 31 | LearnSkillGroup | Learns the skill group a teacher NPC teaches. |
| 32 | UseItemOnSkill | Uses an item of the bag on one of our skills: the skill a soul stone trains, chosen after ChooseSkill. |
| 33 | SendWhisper | Says something to one player only, by its character's name: it must be in the game. |
| 34 | AskFriend | Asks a player in the game to be our friend; it answers with AnswerFriend. |
| 35 | AnswerFriend | Answers a player that asked to be our friend (FriendAsked). |
| 36 | RemoveFriend | Ends a friendship, on both sides; the friend need not be in the game. |
| 37 | RideMount | Gets on our mount (calling it first when it is away and the bag holds its call), or off it. |
| 38 | TrainMount | Trains our mount at a stable NPC to its next level, at that level's costs. |
| 39 | GiveItem | An item of our bag dropped onto an NPC: a smith or a fisher offers to upgrade it, a fire grills it. |
| 40 | UseItemOnItem | One item of our bag put onto another, such as an upgrade scroll onto the item it upgrades. |
| 41 | Upgrade | Upgrades the item an UpgradeOffer showed, at a smith or with a scroll, at its costs. |
| 42 | Cast | Casts our fishing pole's line toward the water that way. |
| 43 | ReelIn | Reels our line in: after a bite, to catch what bit; before one, to stop fishing. |

## Server → client

| Id | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Welcome | The server speaks the client's protocol: the session goes on. |

| 14 | Chat | A chat line. |

| 16 | EntityRemove | An entity is gone from near us. |
| 17 | EntityMove | Another entity walks to a point, stops, attacks or plays a skill's motion. |
| 18 | EntityDied | An entity died; our own character too. |
| 19 | EntityUpdate | What an entity wears, its speeds or its state changed. |
| 20 | EntityInfo | Name, look, level, guild and empire of a player or NPC, after its EntitySpawn. |
| 21 | TargetHealth | Health of the entity we target: after we choose it, and after each hit it takes. |
| 22 | Damage | Damage an entity took, sent to the attacker and to the player hit. |
| 23 | Points | All of our character's points, while loading: those left out are 0. |
| 24 | PointsChanged | Some of our character's points changed: those left out did not. |
| 25 | ItemSet | An item is put in one of our slots, or the slot is cleared. |
| 26 | GroundItemAdd | An item lies on the ground near us: dropped, or come into view. |
| 27 | GroundItemRemove | An item on the ground is gone: picked up, vanished, or out of view. |
| 28 | ItemOwnership | Who may pick up an item on the ground. |
| 29 | ShopOpened | An NPC's shop opens, with what it sells. |
| 30 | ShopRefused | The shop refused a purchase; nothing changed. |
| 31 | QuickSlotSet | What one of our quickslots holds. |
| 32 | QuickSlotCleared | One of our quickslots is empty. |
| 33 | QuickSlotsSwapped | Two of our quickslots swapped what they hold. |
| 34 | Skills | All of our character's skills: after entering, and when one changes. |
| 35 | SkillGroup | Our character's skill group. |
| 36 | SignInOptions | The answer to StartSignIn: the providers players may sign in with, and the nonce the ID token must carry. |
| 37 | SignedIn | The auth server accepted a provider's sign-in: the account and a ticket for the game server. |
| 38 | MoveRefused | The server refused our last move (through a wall, off the map, out of reach): our character stands at this point instead. |
| 39 | Projectile | A monster shot at a target: its attack motion's flying effect flies there. |
| 40 | TeacherOpened | A teacher NPC we talked to shows what it teaches. |
| 41 | ChooseSkill | The item we used trains a skill we choose (a soul stone): the skills it may train now. The choice comes back as UseItemOnSkill. |
| 42 | Whisper | A whisper: a player said something to us only, or the server tells us our own whisper went out. |
| 43 | WhisperRefused | Our whisper did not go out. |
| 44 | Friends | Our character's friends, after entering the game; not sent when it has none. |
| 45 | FriendChanged | A friend became one, stopped being one, came into the game or left it. |
| 46 | FriendAsked | A player asks to be our friend: we answer with AnswerFriend. |
| 47 | FriendNotice | What became of a friend request, ours or one to us. |
| 48 | EntityMount | A player gets on or off a mount; sent after its EntitySpawn while it rides. |
| 49 | MountState | Our character's mount: after entering the game when it has one, and at each change. |

| 53 | UpgradeOffer | What upgrading an item of our bag takes, at a smith or with a scroll, and what a failure does. |
| 54 | Flight | Something flies from one entity to another, as the client's assets show that kind. |

| 56 | EntitySkills | The skills on a player now, whose looks show on it as the client's assets show them: the whole list whenever it changes, empty when the last ends. |
| 57 | Fishing | A step of a player's fishing, to everyone who sees it. |
| 58 | ItemBoosts | What items used raise on our character for now: the whole list whenever it changes, empty when the last ends. |

## Message layouts

### Hello (id 1, client → server)

The client's first message: the protocol version it speaks and its build.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `protocol` | `u16` | The minor version of the protocol (the major one is the TLS ALPN name). |
| `build` | `string<64>` | The client's name and version, for logs; e.g. `openm2 0.1.0`. |

### Pong (id 2, client → server)

Answer to a Ping.

No fields.

### TicketLogin (id 4, client → server)

Logs in on the game server with the ticket the auth server gave.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `username` | `string<64>` | Account name; must match the one the ticket was given for. |
| `ticket` | `blob<32>` | The ticket from SignedIn. **Secret:** blanked in logs and captures. |

### CreateCharacter (id 5, client → server)

Creates a character in a free slot of the account.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `slot` | `u8` | The slot, 0 to 3. |
| `name` | `string<64>` | Its name. |
| `class` | `u8` | Class and gender, 0 to 7. |
| `empire` | `opt<u8>` | The account's empire (1 to 3), chosen with its first character; none afterwards. |

### SelectCharacter (id 6, client → server)

Plays the character in a slot of the character list.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `slot` | `u8` | The slot, 0 to 3. |

### EnterGame (id 7, client → server)

The client has loaded the map and is ready to play.

No fields.

### SendChat (id 8, client → server)

A chat line or chat command typed by the player.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `u8` | Chat kind: 0 talk, 6 shout. |
| `text` | `string<512>` | The line, or a command starting with `/`. |

### CharacterMove (id 9, client → server)

Our character starts walking to a point, stops, attacks or plays a skill's motion.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `u8` | 0 wait (stopped here), 1 move (walking to the point), 2 attack, 3 combo; 128 + n skill motion n (1 to 6, 16 to 21). |
| `argument` | `u8` | The combo's step, from 1; 0 otherwise. |
| `angle` | `u16` | Direction faced, in degrees: 0 south (+y), 90 east, 180 north, 270 west. |
| `x` | `i32` | Move: the point walked to. Other kinds: where we are. In centimetres. |
| `y` | `i32` | As x. |
| `time` | `u32` | Our estimate of the server's clock (GameTime), in milliseconds. |

|---|---|---|

| `attack_speed` | `u8` | Attack speed, as in EntitySpawn. |
| `state` | `u8` | Flags, as in EntitySpawn. |
| `affects` | `u64` | Effects shown, as in EntitySpawn. |
| `guild` | `u32` | Guild id; 0 for none. |

## Structs

### Character

A character of the account, as the character list shows it.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `slot` | `u8` | Its slot, 0 to 3. |
| `id` | `u32` | Character id. |
| `name` | `string<64>` | Name. |
| `class` | `u8` | Class and gender, 0 to 7. |
| `level` | `u8` | Level. |
| `playtime` | `u32` | Time played, as the server counts it. |
| `st` | `u8` | Strength. |
| `ht` | `u8` | Vitality. |
| `dx` | `u8` | Dexterity. |
| `iq` | `u8` | Intelligence. |
| `body_part` | `u16` | Armour shown on the body (an item number); 0 for none. |
| `hair_part` | `u16` | Hair style shown. |
| `guild` | `string<64>` | Guild name; empty for none. |

### PointValue

One of our character's points and its value.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `point` | `u8` | Point number: 1 level, 3 experience, 5 health, 6 most health, 7 mana, 8 most mana, 11 gold, 28 skill points, … |
| `value` | `u32` | Its value. |

### ItemBonus

A bonus on an item.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `u8` | Bonus number, from 1. |
| `value` | `u16` | Its value. |

### ShopGood

Something an NPC's shop sells.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `position` | `u8` | Its place: 5 wide and 8 high, numbered x + 5 y; a tall item covers the places below it. |
| `vnum` | `u32` | Item number. |
| `price` | `u32` | Gold for the whole stack. |
| `count` | `u8` | How many one purchase gives. |

### SkillState

One of our character's skills.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `skill` | `u8` | The skill's number. |
| `level` | `u8` | 1 to 19 normal, 20 to 29 master (M1 to M10), 30 to 39 grand master (G1 to G10), 40 perfect master. |
| `grade` | `u8` | 0 normal, 1 master, 2 grand master, 3 perfect master. |
| `next_read` | `u32` | When the next skill book may be read, in seconds since 1970; 0 for any time. |

### Affect

A point a skill raises on our character for now.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `skill` | `u8` | The skill that raised it. |
| `point` | `u8` | What it raises: 1 attack speed, 2 movement speed, 3 attack grade, 4 defence, 5 resistance, 6 reflection, 7 critical hits, 8 dodging, 9 health from hits, 10 mana shield, 11 casting speed, 12 hidden, 13 strength, 14 dexterity, 15 vitality, 16 intelligence. |
| `amount` | `i32` | By how much: percent for speeds and chances, points for grades and the rest. |
| `seconds` | `u32` | Seconds left, rounded up; 0 while a skill that stays on is on. |

### ItemBoost

A point an item used raises on our character for now.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `item` | `u32` | The item that raised it. |
| `point` | `u8` | What it raises, as Affect's point. |
| `amount` | `i32` | By how much, as Affect's amount. |
| `seconds` | `u32` | Seconds left, rounded up. |

### Provider

An OpenID Connect provider players may sign in with.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string<16>` | Its id on this server: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. |
| `name` | `string<64>` | Its name, for the button. |
| `authorize` | `string<512>` | Its authorization endpoint, an `https` URL. |
| `client_id` | `string<256>` | The server's client id at the provider. |

### Friend

One of our character's friends.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string<24>` | Its name, as it was created. |
| `online` | `bool` | Whether it is in the game now. |

### MountCost

Items training a mount uses up.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `vnum` | `u32` | Item number. |
| `count` | `u8` | How many. |

### UpgradeCost

Items an upgrade uses up.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `vnum` | `u32` | Item number. |
| `count` | `u8` | How many. |

### MountOffer

The mount level a stable trains ours to next, and what it takes.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `level` | `u8` | The level it reaches; 1 is the first mount. |
| `grade` | `u8` | The mount's grade at that level. |
| `look` | `u16` | The monster the mount looks like at that level. |
| `move_speed` | `u8` | Its rider's movement speed at that level. |
| `stamina` | `u16` | The most stamina it has at that level. |
| `rider_level` | `u8` | The character level training needs. |
| `gold` | `u32` | The gold it costs. |
| `items` | `list<MountCost; 8>` | The items it uses up. |
| `skill_points` | `u8` | The horseback skill points reaching it gives. |
